name: test-driven-development
tagline_zh: 写代码前先写测试？听起来反直觉，但能让你少熬夜调 bug。这个 skill 会一步步带你从红到绿。
tagline_en: Write tests before code? Counterintuitive, but it saves your late-night debugging. This skill walks you.
desc_en: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code
why_zh: 它不只是提醒你写测试，而是把 TDD 拆成可执行的步骤，连你最容易漏的边界条件都替你盯着。
why_en: It doesn't just remind you to test—it breaks TDD into actionable steps and watches for edge cases you'd likely miss.
